subject: a sunflower radio character
art_direction: 芥黄色向日葵身体像小收音机，深蓝旋钮和橙色花瓣有序排列。
visible_description: 芥黄色向日葵身体像小收音机，深蓝旋钮和橙色花瓣有序排列。
composition: Square 1024x1024 avatar. The distinct subject, face, object or abstract form occupies about 65–80% of the canvas, and remains readable at small size. Important features sit safely near the center with room for a circular crop, but DO NOT draw a circular frame, badge, disc backdrop or circular mask. Render a complete square background. Vary silhouette, expression, angle, asymmetry, and density as the individual direction requests. Appealing eyes and a purposeful expression matter when a face is present; never force a face onto a faceless concept.
creative_direction: Invent a sunflower-shaped radio character with a mustard body, broad orange petals and two navy knobs below a tiny attentive face. Lean one side forward as if listening, keeping every dial blank. Use flat risograph shapes, cream paper gaps and gentle ink grain. The cheerful design stays compact and original, without nostalgic brand cues or surrounding music symbols. Square 1024x1024, centered with a distinct silhouette and generous circular-crop clearance, without a circular frame. Original peaceful design, no text, branding, or watermark.
